# Vendored Offline Frontend Libraries

This directory contains offline frontend assets for StudyRAG V2.2:

1. **Mermaid.js** (`static/vendor/mermaid/mermaid.min.js`)
   - **Version**: 10.9.1
   - **License**: MIT License
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid
   - **Purpose**: Local, zero-CDN rendering of flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state machines, class diagrams, entity-relationship diagrams, and academic workflows.

2. **Marked.js** (`static/vendor/marked/marked.min.js`)
   - **Version**: 12.0.2
   - **License**: MIT License
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
   - **Purpose**: Local Markdown parsing for grounded explanations.

3. **Highlight.js** (`static/vendor/highlight/highlight.min.js`, `static/vendor/highlight/github-dark.min.css`)
   - **Version**: 11.9.0
   - **License**: BSD 3-Clause License
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
   - **Purpose**: Syntax highlighting for code and configuration blocks in chat messages.
